subject: Easily Print all R code in Appendix

messages.author: cdb6dd984ece5b15
messages.subject: Easily Print all R code in Appendix
parts:
Hi All,

I'm often use knitr to produce reports and generally like to have all my R code appear in an appendix at the end of the document. I currently copy and paste everything into a chunk in the appendix with echo=T and eval=F as options but this is often very tedious. In fact, sometimes I change some of the code within the document which makes things even more awkward if I forget to update the appendix. Has anyone experimented with options for easily printing all the code in an appendix automatically? Thanks for your feedback and help!
